messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['As an AOL member, You need to Update your AOL Webmail profile.', 'To impede the deletion of your Apple camp; iCloud please proceed to continue to your Apple ID profile before the planned emotion time.', 'If you have not updated your account, Kindly fill the columns below and send it back, so we can update our database immediately.', 'You are required to verify your details to resolve access issues and irregularities which we noticed with your webmail account last month.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
